answer.rationale: Memory 44 directly supports qualified pipeline quality, and memory 57 explicitly reports qualified revenue with no measured retention harm, though neither establishes long-term durability. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or early adoption improvements but omit downstream qualification, monetization, retention, and revenue outcomes. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift for price-sensitive SMBs, but omits unit economics, retention, and whether discounting is sustainable. Memory 91 reports only week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no evidence of conversion, revenue quality, retention, or durability.
